'''Chris Simmons''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 29th at [[2001 Georgia State Championship]] on 5 May 2001 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWYHL test to 5 with heavy space]], according to Charlie Herren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2248">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-06-wal-mart-stickers-and-the-anti-drawd2248/ wal-mart-stickers-and-the-anti-draw], DeckTech (Charlie "Bad Player" Herren, 6 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-06-wal-mart-stickers-and-the-anti-drawd2248/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
